h1: Custom Plastic Badge Reels for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Plastic Badge Reels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom plastic badge reels in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for ID cards and lanyards with vibrant imprinting.
introHtml: Plastic badge reels offer a lightweight, durable solution for everyday ID access. Unlike metal reels, plastic options are more affordable for large teams and come in opaque or translucent finishes that hold color well. They work with standard ID cards and lanyards, and are easy to customize with screen printing or pad printing for logos. Perfect for trade shows, offices, or events where you need a reliable, budget-friendly badge holder.
heroAltText: Custom plastic badge reels with retractable cord and logo imprint for ID cards
